annotations.title: Watch the case for new filings

description: Begin continuous monitoring of a saved case, so that the user is alerted when anything new is filed. Use when the user asks to monitor, watch, track or follow a case, or to be told about future activity in it. The case must be saved first, with find_federal_case then create_case_passport. If monitoring is not active on the account, or the account is already watching as many cases as it covers, this still succeeds with watching false and a next_step saying what to tell the user; do not describe it as an error, because nothing has failed. It never charges anyone.

matter_id.description: The CaseMagic matter id, as returned by create_case_passport or shown in an earlier result. Omit it when the account follows exactly one case and that is the one meant.

name: watch_case

checkout_url.description: Where the user starts a plan, when one is needed.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: a code, a message and, where there is one, an action such as a link to give the user.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, for example CASE_NOT_FOUND or MULTIPLE_CASES_FOUND.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

plans.description: Plans that include watching, with price, cases covered and trial.

status.description: The watch status, or why the case is not being watched.

upgrade_url.description: Where the user moves to a plan that covers this case, when theirs is full.
